items.title: GitHub - oxynote/oxynote: An open‑source technical wiki connected to the systems it describes
items.summary: Your system, with subtitles. A self-hosted workspace that puts live metric charts and logs inside the pages that explain them. They run your Prometheus, Loki and SQL queries, and a change to a page goes through a draft, a diff and an approval, like a pull request. From the authors of ttlcache. Ke...
